name: Jepeta Risk Guard
description: Fail-closed pre-trade risk guard for Base agents

freeVsPaid.free: Public V5 POST exact-token scan, V4 GET compatibility preview, plus public discovery risk feed.
freeVsPaid.paid: Full evidence report through Virtuals ACP v2 / token_risk_scan.

exampleResponse.note: Illustrative V4 compatibility response generated from synthetic source inputs. It is not the canonical V5 response and not a live scan.

limitations: Screening only; not a smart-contract audit, safety guarantee, price prediction, or investment recommendation.
Only Base ERC-20 contracts on chain 8453 are supported.
GoPlus is required for strict honeypot and mintability evidence; unknown required values fail closed with HTTP 422.
DEX Screener market context can be partial, rate-limited, or unavailable; missing values are not converted to zero.
The public risk feed contains published discovery signals only and is not a census of Base or all Jepeta scans.

changes.summary: Separated acquisition attribution from internal surfaces and hardened search/AI discovery semantics.
changes: Evidence and Guides no longer use internal UTM sources as acquisition channels; first-touch, landing surface and current touch are separated.
Scanner/share state uses fragment-based URLs to avoid crawlable token/tracking query variants while retaining legacy query compatibility.
Public Evidence exposes snapshot-bounded on-chain token name/symbol when available and labels historical verdicts as snapshots.
Virtuals ACP pricing is machine-explicit as 0.03 USDC per scan, per request, non-recurring and not a subscription.
Canonical V5 POST examples are primary; V4 GET is explicitly compatibility-only.

changes.summary: Migrated the default public POST scanner to V5 after a 24-token live coverage gate, while retaining explicit and default GET V4 compatibility and a service-role rollback switch.
changes: A valid GoPlus response omitting cannot_sell_all preserves UNKNOWN and degrades quality; it never fabricates false or a full-sellability claim.
Unconfirmed exact-token Base liquidity yields WARN with zero score delta, preserving V4 decision parity without changing observed-liquidity thresholds.
Explicit true continues to BLOCK; malformed, stale, unavailable and conflicting required security evidence remains NO_VERDICT.
V4 remains active and supported; pricing, paid exposure and public Evidence v2 history are unchanged.

changes.summary: Rolled API V5 from internal through canary to a public optional explicit endpoint while keeping V4 canonical/default and preserving rollback.
changes: Published the separate /jepeta-risk-scan-v5 endpoint as optional and non-canonical; V4 remains active, supported, canonical and default.
Kept the frozen 5.0.0-internal.1 P14/P15 response contract, Risk Engine v3 semantics, pricing and paid/non-public boundary unchanged.
Added reversible internal/canary/public rollout state plus the existing Jepeta rate limiter; the API V5 master flag remains an immediate kill switch.
No V4 redirect, alias, deprecation, sunset or mandatory migration was introduced.

changes.summary: Published provider governance, Methodology v2, public Evidence v2 and branding safeguards without changing V4 verdict semantics, pricing or paid/non-public exposure.
changes: Added /sources/ and sources.json generated from the authoritative provider registry.
Documented Raw Observation -> Normalized Evidence -> Conflict Detection -> Jepeta Rule -> Verdict and the Risk Engine v3 rule trace.
Upgraded public evidence to schema 2.0.0 with explicit per-item provenance/freshness/status and public-safe conflicts; raw provider payloads and paid/non-public fields remain excluded.
Kept API V4 active/supported/canonical and API V5 internal/non-canonical.
Added CI guards for machine-surface divergence and unsupported partnership/endorsement branding claims.

changes.summary: Repositioned Jepeta as a fail-closed pre-trade risk guard for Base agents without changing API or decision contracts.
changes: Made the pre-trade agent risk guard the canonical product identity across website, SEO, machine discovery, documentation and distribution copy.
Kept exact-token scanning as the human preview and underlying screening component.
Kept PASS/WARN/BLOCK semantics, endpoints, schemas, pricing rails and existing integration identifiers backward compatible.
Aligned Telegram, Farcaster and Virtuals-facing descriptions without claiming safety or adoption.

changes.summary: Published monthly Base risk research and a public aggregate risk-intelligence API.
changes: Added reproducible monthly Base risk intelligence from one latest HIGH/MEDIUM-quality observation per unique token.
Added public aggregate risk-intelligence API plus indexable research pages.
Published research methodology and sample limitations alongside the public results.
Added 20 unique English direct-answer pages under /guides/.
Added companion JSON for every guide plus a machine-readable guide catalog.
Grounded guide pages in methodology, current public evidence examples, sources, limitations and fresh-scan CTAs.
Added WebPage + Article + BreadcrumbList structured data without FAQPage/QAPage misuse.
Added guide URLs to sitemap generation, IndexNow discovery, llms and agent discovery surfaces.

changes.summary: Added permanent evidence-rich public Base token pages.
changes: Added a GET-only public risk-evidence API.
Added stable HTML + JSON URLs under /risk/base/0xTOKEN/.
Indexing is gated to already-published HIGH/MEDIUM evidence-rich tokens; ordinary scans are not auto-indexed.
Paid-only dangerous-permission flags, liquidity-risk synthesis and trading-activity evidence remain excluded.
Added eligible evidence URLs to the sitemap and IndexNow discovery.
Added canonical methodology.json and changelog.json.
Added last-updated, canonical, free-vs-paid, endpoint, example, and limitation metadata across machine surfaces.
Risk feed envelope upgraded to schemaVersion 1.1.0 with embedded Jepeta service metadata.
OpenAPI document upgraded to 4.2.0 and linked to methodology and changelog.

changes.summary: Established the canonical Jepeta Risk Guard entity.
changes: Canonical domain set to jepeta.dev.
Linked Organization, SoftwareApplication/WebApplication, and WebAPI structured entities.
Aligned external identity references across public surfaces.

changes.summary: Published the bounded public Base risk discovery feed.
changes: Added recent public PASS/WARN/BLOCK discovery signals.
Kept paid evidence excluded from the public feed.
